'''2016 European Championship Day 2 David Destefanis LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David Destefanis]] at [[2016 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[David Destefanis]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Username:''' DDM
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
